relationshipBasis.stated: A verse names both and states the relationship (begat, son of, wife, brother …).
relationshipBasis.named-together: Both are named in this verse; the relationship itself comes from the dataset and awaits review.
relationshipBasis.not-identified: No verse stating this link has been identified yet; it comes from the dataset and awaits review.

people.name: Abraham
people.summary: Called out of Haran into Canaan (Genesis 12). Named Abram until Genesis 17:5.

curatedRelationships.phrase: the name of Abram’s wife was Sarai

people.name: Boaz
people.summary: Named Booz in Matthew 1:5; father of Obed by Ruth.

people.name: David
people.summary: Son of Jesse, anointed at Beth-lehem; king in Hebron, then in Jerusalem (2 Samuel 5).

people.name: Herod the king
people.summary: Herod I, king of Judaea (Matthew 2).

people.name: Hosea
people.summary: Prophet in the days of Uzziah … Hezekiah and Jeroboam (Hosea 1:1).

people.name: Isaac
people.summary: Son of Abraham.

people.name: Isaiah
people.summary: Prophet in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah (Isaiah 1:1).

people.name: Jacob
people.summary: Son of Isaac, renamed Israel (Genesis 35:10). Father of the twelve sons.

curatedRelationships.phrase: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin

people.name: Jeremiah
people.summary: Prophet from the thirteenth year of Josiah to the carrying away of Jerusalem (Jeremiah 1:2–3). Matthew calls him Jeremy.

people.name: Jesse
people.summary: The Beth-lehemite, father of David.

people.name: Jesus
people.summary: “Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham” (Matthew 1:1).

curatedRelationships.phrase: Mary, of whom was born Jesus

people.name: Jethro
people.summary: Priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law.

people.name: Joseph (husband of Mary)
people.summary: “Joseph the husband of Mary” (Matthew 1:16); called “thou son of David” (Matthew 1:20).

people.name: Joseph (son of Jacob)
people.summary: Son of Jacob and Rachel; sold into Egypt (Genesis 37).

curatedRelationships.phrase: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin

people.name: Judah
people.summary: Son of Jacob and Leah (Genesis 35:23). Matthew spells the name Judas (Matthew 1:2–3).

people.name: Lot
people.summary: Son of Haran, Abram’s nephew.

people.name: Mary
people.summary: Mother of Jesus (Matthew 1:16).

curatedRelationships.phrase: Mary, of whom was born Jesus

people.name: Micah

people.name: Moses

people.name: Rachel

curatedRelationships.phrase: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin

people.name: Ruth

curatedRelationships.phrase: Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law

people.name: Samuel
people.summary: Prophet who anointed David at Beth-lehem (1 Samuel 16).

people.name: Sarah
people.summary: Wife of Abraham. Named Sarai in these chapters.

people.name: Saul
people.summary: First king of Israel, rejected in 1 Samuel 16:1.

people.name: Solomon
people.summary: Son of David (Matthew 1:6); built the house of the LORD in mount Moriah (2 Chronicles 3:1).

people.name: Terah
